data.description: 【调月莉音 · 千年楼顶俯瞰】千年科学学园千米摩天楼顶的天台上，黑色风衣下摆在狂风中猎猎作响。莉音双手插兜俯瞰着脚下整座璀璨的科技之城，红瞳中映着星火——「整座城市的运作逻辑都在我的计算之内。但唯独你……老师，你每一次做出的选择，都会彻底打破我的精密模型呢。」
data.promptProse: Rio stands on the Millennium tower rooftop with hands in her long winter coat pockets, looking over the technology city as wind lifts the belted hem. The low wide view places the roof edge beneath her boots and illuminated streets far below. Dusk sky outlines her dark hair and shoulders; city lights reflect faintly along the coat's lower edge, with overlapping tower silhouettes carrying the depth behind her.
data.title: 调月莉音 · 千年楼顶俯瞰
